definitions.explanation: The spherical organ of sight. Used in medical, scientific, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {眼球|がんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
{眼球|がんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned about the structure of the eyeball.

examples.japanese: ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{眼球|がんきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}き→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using a computer for long periods makes the eyeballs prone to drying out.

notes:
Compound of {眼|がん} (eye) + ⟦{球|きゅう}→球：28895_kyuu⟧ (ball, sphere). The standard term for the physical eyeball.

USAGE:
Used in both medical/scientific contexts and everyday language. More clinical than ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye), which is the everyday word. {眼球|がんきゅう} specifically refers to the physical globe of the eye, while ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ can refer to the eye, eyesight, or vision more broadly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {眼球|がんきゅう}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ — eye movement
- {眼球|がんきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧ — eyeballs dry out
- {眼球|がんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧ — surface of the eyeball
- {眼球|がんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧ — to move one's eyeballs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ — eye (everyday, broader usage)
- ⟦{目玉|めだま}→目玉：13649_medama⟧ — eyeball (more colloquial; also means "highlight" or "featured item")
- ⟦{瞳|ひとみ}→瞳：02252_hitomi⟧ — pupil, eye (poetic, often used for the iris/pupil area)
